title: Pricing Electric Vehicle Charging and Station Access via Copositive Duality
summary: Optimized charging of electric vehicles (EVs) at public locations consists of two decisions: how much energy to deliver at what times, which is continuous, and where to plug in, which is binary. This makes optimizing EV charging a mixed-integer linear program (MILP). This discreteness undermines traditional marginal pricing methods. In this paper, we develop the first marginal-price-based mechanism for pricing EV charging with binary station access constraints.
